mentions.name: Nutrisense (v6)
mentions.description: Version 6 of Nutrisense, a hardware device that tracks what you eat — calories, protein, and other nutrients — automatically, without needing to type food intake into an app.
mentions.problem: Tracking food intake typically requires manually typing meals into an app, which this device eliminates.
mentions.audience: A people who want to track their own food intake without manual logging; implied individual/personal use
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on version 6 of the Nutrisense. A device to keep track of what you eat (calories/protein, etc.) without the need to type it in, in some app.

evidence.value: I am working on version 6 of the Nutrisense. A device to keep track of what you eat (calories/protein, etc.) without the need to type it in, in some app.
